title.en: What job fits the German type mortar sprayer?
title.zh: 德式砂浆喷涂机对得上什么作业？

description.en: Mortar inside 3–5 m³/h, ≤ 5 mm, 8 MPa, 40 m / 20 m, on 380 V dual motors 7.5/9 kW. It is not the 5 m³/h hydraulic concrete sprayer.
description.zh: 砂浆在 3–5 m³/h、≤ 5 mm、8 MPa、40 m / 20 m 内，380V 双电机 7.5/9 kW。它不是 5 m³/h 液压混凝土喷涂机。

h1.en: What job fits the German type mortar sprayer?
h1.zh: 德式砂浆喷涂机对得上什么作业？

directAnswer.en: Mortar spraying inside 3–5 m³/h and ≤ 5 mm, with 380 V for 7.5/9 kW dual motors. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 8 MPa, hose 32/38 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤ 1:3, 40 m horizontal / 20 m vertical, 1700 × 650 × 800 mm and 360 kg. It is not a trailer pump and not the hydraulic concrete sprayer that also uses 7.5/9 kW.
directAnswer.zh: 砂浆喷涂在 3–5 m³/h 和 ≤ 5 mm 内，并且有 380V 供给 7.5/9 kW 双电机。邢台河北品锦机械印了 8 MPa、管径 32/38 mm、砂灰比 ≤ 1:3、水平 40 m / 垂直 20 m、外形 1700 × 650 × 800 mm、360 kg。它不是拖泵，也不是同样使用 7.5/9 kW 的液压混凝土喷涂机。

heading.en: Same motors, different machine from the 5 m³/h sprayer
heading.zh: 电机数字相同，和 5 m³/h 喷涂机不是一台

body.en: The hydraulic concrete sprayer prints 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤ 8 mm, 100 m / 50 m and 295 kg. The German type prints 3–5 m³/h, 32/38 mm, ≤ 5 mm, 40 m / 20 m and 360 kg. Shared motor figures and 8 MPa do not merge the hose, the particle or the distance.
body.zh: 液压混凝土喷涂机印的是 7.5/9 kW、5 m³/h、8 MPa、管径 38/51 mm、粒径 ≤ 8 mm、100 m / 50 m、295 kg。德式机印的是 3–5 m³/h、32/38 mm、≤ 5 mm、40 m / 20 m、360 kg。电机数字和 8 MPa 相同，并不能合并软管、粒径或距离。

heading.en: Type 511 is the narrower 3 m³/h neighbour

body.en: Type 511 is 7.5 kW, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, ≤ 6 mm and 30 m / 15 m. Choose the German type when you need the printed 3–5 m³/h band, 8 MPa and ≤ 5 mm, not when the particle is 6 mm.
body.zh: 511 是 7.5 kW、3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、≤ 6 mm、30 m / 15 m。需要已印的 3–5 m³/h、8 MPa 和 ≤ 5 mm 时选德式机；粒径是 6 mm 时不要选它。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say ≤ 5 mm only if the particle really is inside that cell. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 只有粒径确实在这一格内时，才写 ≤ 5 mm。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Is “German type” a country of origin claim?

answer.en: It is the catalogue name printed by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. This page does not turn it into a German project or a German factory.
answer.zh: 它是邢台河北品锦机械印出的目录名称。本页不把它写成德国项目或德国工厂。

answer.en: No. The page prints 380 V. No-grid mortar spraying in this output class is Type 511 diesel.
answer.zh: 不。这一页印的是 380V。这一档没有电网的砂浆喷涂是 511 柴油机。

answer.en: It is the printed range. Do not replace it with 5 m³/h from the hydraulic sprayer.
answer.zh: 它是已印的区间。不要用液压喷涂机的 5 m³/h 替换它。
